LEGAL NOTICE NO. 12 OF 2023
Money Laundering (Administrative Sanctions) Rules, 2023
Pursuant to sections 18B(1)(c) and 18D, of the Money Laundering and Proceeds
1
of Crime Act, 2008 , I,
EMMANUEL MALUKE LETETE
being the Governor of the Central Bank, a financial sector supervisory authority,
make the following Rules -
Citation and commencement
1. These Rules may be cited as the Money Laundering (Administrative
Sanctions) Rules, 2023 and shall come into operation on the date of publication
in the Gazette.
Interpretation
2. (1) In these Rules,
“Act” means Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act, 2008; and
“Central Bank” means the Central Bank of Lesotho established by the
2
Central Bank of Lesotho Act, 2000 .
(2) All other words used in these Rules have the same meaning as-
signed to them under the Act.
Objective
3. The objective of these Rules is to provide for administrative sanctions
regime for breach of the provisions of the Act and its implementing regulations
by accountable institutions, which are supervised by the Central Bank.
Application
4. (1) These Rules shall apply to accountable institutions licensed and
supervised by the Central Bank.

88
(2) Where there are contradictions between these Rules and the Act
and its implementing regulations, the Act and its implementing regulations shall
apply.
Procedure for imposing sanctions
5. Where the Central Bank intends to impose a sanction, it shall issue a
written notice to an accountable institution indicating the -
(a) right of the accountable institution to show cause why
such sanctions may not be imposed on it; and
(b) sanction that it intends to impose.
Administrative sanctions
6. (1) The Central Bank may impose the following administrative
sanctions upon an accountable institution for any contravention of the provisions
of the Act, its implementing Regulations and these Rules:
(a) direct that the members of the Board of Directors and
senior management of the accountable institution be
removed from their roles;
(b) prohibit the accountable institution from providing or
operating certain product or certain processes;
(c) a temporary or permanent prohibition on any natural
person who holds a managerial position in the
accountable institution from taking decisions relating to
the accountable institution;
(d) direct the accountable institution to undertake any given
actions to -
(i) comply with the requirements within a specified
period through a remedial plan;
(ii) conduct internal inquiries and submit a report to
the Central Bank; or

89
(iii) take disciplinary action against directors, senior
management or other officers.
(2) An accountable institution shall pay financial penalty imposed
on it in terms of the Act within 30 days of its issuance.
Amendment or repeal of the Rules
7. The Central Bank may from time to time amend or repeal the Rules.
DATED:
DR. EMMANUEL MALUKE LETETE
GOVERNOR OF THE CENTRAL BANK OF LESOTHO
NOTE
1. Act No. 4 of 2008 as amended by Act No. 7 of 2016
2. Act No. 2 of 2000
LEGAL NOTICE NO. 13 OF 2023
Declaration of Land Set Aside for Public Interest at Manonyane A04
Community Council Notice, 2023
1
In exercise of the powers conferred on me by section 51 of the Land Act, 2010 ,
I,
LEBONA FABIAN LEPHEMA
minister responsible for local government, chieftainship, home affairs and police
after having consulted with Manonyane A04 Community Council hereby declare
that the Land described in this Notice is set aside for public purposes.
Description : Every right or interest in and to the land
described as unnumbered agricultural plot
situated opposite Christ the King High School,
enroute to St Joseph hospital on the right
hand side, on the eastern side is the weather

90
station and it is on the northern side of St Joseph
hospital at Roma in the district of Maseru
covering in extent 46,670 square meters.
Lessee : Roma School of Nursing
Purpose : The land is required for institutional purpose.
Date of Surrender : On the date of publication of this notice in the
gazette all interests in or affecting the said land
shall cease to subsist and allottees interest in the
land shall revert to the state.
Compensation : No compensation as the Land is donated to the
Lessee
Claims : Any person having any claim in the land so set
aside may submit his claim for compensation to
the Minister by forwarding the details thereof to
the Commissioner of Lands, P.O. Box 87,
Maseru, 100 within three (3) months of the date
of publication of this Notice in the Gazette.
DATED:
LEBONA FABIAN LEPHEMA
MINISTER OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT, CHIEFTAINSHIP,
HOME AFFAIRS AND POLICE
